task: Diagnose: QR connected but no auto reply
summary: Rowad Alfa WhatsApp QR / auto-reply / content-sync repair (Claude Code). ROOT CAUSES fixed: (1) replies were re-addressed from the incoming @lid chat to the phone JID (key.senderPn); Baileys 6.7.24 keys Signal sessions by address, so every phone-JID send forked the session -> next inbound 'Bad MAC' -> 6-7 s WhatsApp retry (the 'delay') -> retry lacked senderPn -> customer keyed by LID digits = second customer record -> welcome/language flow repeated ('Hello, welcome to The Business'), and eventually 'Waiting for this message' on the phone. Now: reply ALWAYS to key.remoteJid as received; customer identity = phone JID via senderPn or the new whatsapp_lid_map table (LID<->phone pairings learned from messages and contacts.upsert/update). (2) Dashboard text != WhatsApp text: menu.ts generated option lists/footers in code and preview hard-coded options. Now templates carry the full Antigravity content (61 templates: welcome/language, 9-option main menu, 4 submenus + 25 detail texts, prices/offers menu + 4 info texts, location, about, appointment 8-step flow, quotation 4-step flow, support/error texts) and are sent verbatim; option number -> action lives in src/automation/menuRouter.ts (MAIN_MENU_OPTIONS/SUBMENUS/FLOWS/FOLLOW_UP_TEMPLATES); preview endpoint uses the live renderer and returns the follow-up bubble. (3) Bot replies were not persisted in the menu path -> every inbound/outbound bubble now stored (dashboard conversations complete). (4) BUSINESS_NAME env default 'The Business' -> 'Rowad Alfa Auto Care'. (5) Stale offline-backlog messages (>10 min old) are stored as suppressed, never auto-answered. (6) Appointment/quotation requests persisted in customer_requests with APT-/INQ- references; dashboard Bookings page lists them with status control; /api/dashboard/requests, /menu-tree added; flow map rebuilt from the router tree; WhatsApp-style preview (RTL/LTR, follow-up bubble, draft/live badge). Template upgrade logic: default text refreshed, live text moved only when unmodified, retired 'welcome' removed when unmodified. Migration 012 (additive): whatsapp_lid_map, customer_requests, customers.menu_state/flow_data/reply_jid. Baileys stays 6.7.24 (Antigravity uses ^6.7.19). No Meta API. No numeric prices (zero-fabricated-pricing). Antigravity reference project untouched; its server on port 3005 left running and untouched per user instruction. NOTE: between 12:12 and 12:20 the saved Baileys session disappeared (only code path: WhatsApp loggedOut handler or dashboard Log out); user re-scanned at ~12:21; a warn log line was added to the loggedOut branch for future evidence.
